headline: Software development, grounded in real workflows.
introduction: I am an Information Technology: Software Development student building Android and Windows applications. I like joining the dots between understanding a problem, shaping a useful workflow, and checking that the details hold up.
about: I am completing the Information Technology: Software Development program at New Brunswick Community College, with expected graduation in 2027 and a cumulative GPA of 3.91. My project work spans Android with Kotlin and Windows desktop software with C# and WPF.

I bring a customer-service and operations mindset to software: clarify what should happen, document blockers and edge cases, and verify changes across the paths people use. I am interested in work that connects implementation, product thinking, and careful quality checks.
